lede: Who knew an 'Okay okay, haa' would become one of the most beautiful friendships of my life? 🥹🤍✨
message:
*Happy Friendship Day, Kaaggduuuu!* 🤍🫂🌸

It's funny how life works. The person who once greeted me with just an *"Okay okay, haa"* 😄 eventually became one of the most important people in my life. 🥹🤍

We joined the same company as colleagues, but somewhere between project discussions 💻, late-night work 🌙, endless fights 😤, silly teasing 😝, random arguments 😂, countless "Moulin sirrrr..." calls 📣, and always having each other's back 🫂... you quietly became my Bestie. 🥹🤍✨

Some friendships don't need years to become special, they just need the right person. 💞 And I'm truly grateful that life introduced me to someone like *you*. 🥺🫶🏻🌷

Whenever I think about iRoid, I don't just remember the work or the projects. I remember laughing until our stomachs hurt 😂💖, arguing over the smallest things 😤, helping each other during stressful moments 🫂, celebrating little wins 🎉, and creating memories that I'll cherish forever. 🥹🤍✨ Those moments made my journey so beautiful. 🌈💫

Even though we don't sit in the same office anymore 😔, nothing has changed for me. 🤍 You're still the first person I feel like sharing good news with 🥹, asking for advice 💭, complaining to 😤, or simply annoying for absolutely no reason. 😂💞

Thank you for trusting me 🤍, believing in me 🌸, standing by me 🫂, supporting me through every challenge 💪🏻, caring for me in your own unique way 🥹💖, and making even the most ordinary days feel unforgettable. ✨ You made my office life brighter than you probably realize. 🌷🤍

I hope you achieve everything you've ever dreamed of. 🌸✨ You deserve every happiness, every success, and every beautiful thing this world has to offer. 🥹🤍 May your smile never fade 😊🌼, your heart always stay peaceful 🤍, and may life always be kind to you. 🌈🦋

And yes... please keep fighting with me 😤😂, teasing me 😝, making fun of me 🤭, and calling me *"loommdiiii..."* 😌🫶🏻 because honestly... it wouldn't feel like us without all that. 🥹💖

No matter where life takes us, you'll always be my favorite fighting partner 😤😂, my biggest headache 🤦🏻‍♂️💞, my emergency contact for random nonsense 📞😂, and one of the most precious people in my life. ♾️🤍🫂

Distance can change workplaces, but it can never change a friendship built with trust, care, laughter, and countless memories. 🥹🤍🌸

Happy Friendship Day, My Kaaggduuuu! 🥹🫂💖🌷

photos.caption: Every project had deadlines… but every memory had you. 💻🤍✨
Every little celebration became special because you were there. 🎂🥹🤍
Pooof that elegance isn't just in how you look… it's in the beautiful person you are. 🌸🤍✨
The same smile that made even stressful office days feel lighter. 🥹💞
It looks like just a photo… but for me, it's a lifetime of memories in one frame. 🥹🤍

surprises: May your smile always stay brighter than your screen during late-night deployments. 🌸😊
No matter how busy life gets, you're never losing me. 🤍♾️
Permission to keep annoying me: Lifetime Approved. 😂🤍
extraNote:
Thank you for being one of the most beautiful chapters of my life. 📖🤍✨ I honestly can't imagine my iRoid journey without you, and I'll always be grateful that our paths crossed. 🥹💞

Always and forever... ♾️🤍🫂🌸

**Your "Moulin sir"** 😌🫶🏻🤍
oneMore: If I could relive my iRoid journey... I'd still choose the same interview day, because that's where I found you. 🥹🤍✨ Happy Friendship Day, Kaaggduuuu... and thank you for becoming one of the best things that ever happened to me. ♾️🤍🫂
